roles.title: Director-General

details.imageSource: M’Bow, November 1974, UNESCO, photographer Dominique Roger
details.summary: Senegalese politician and seventh Director-General of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) 1974-1987
details.life: Was born 20 March 1921 in Dakar, French West Africa and died 24 September 2024 in Dakar, Senegal. He was the son of Fara N’Diaye M’Bow, farmer, and NGoné Casset. On 27 July 1951 he married Raymonde Sylvain, educator, with whom he had two daughters and one son.
details.editors: Bob Reinalda, Kent J. Kille and Jaci L. Eisenberg
